_about: Exercise library for the strength planner. Nothing here is about one athlete. 'requires' are equipment tags the user must have (athlete.json equipment.tags); 'garmin' lists Garmin 'category/exercise' names used to match a user's own history (read from their FIT files). 'kind': heavy = loadable, bw = bodyweight/tempo, iso = timed hold, plyo = jumps (count contacts), speed = sprint or drill work. 'level' 1 = easiest. 'banned_tags' are matched against athlete.json constraints.no_exercises (push-up, pull-up, chin-up are never prescribed to a user who cannot do them). Which exercise is best for a goal is mostly practice: see references/evidence-map.md.

equipment_tags.barbell: a barbell (a convertible handle pair counts)
equipment_tags.band_anchor: a sturdy anchor point for a band
equipment_tags.step: a stair, box or sturdy chair to step on
equipment_tags.slider: towel or sliders on a smooth floor
equipment_tags.anchor_feet: something to hook the heels under (sofa, partner)
equipment_tags.hill: a hill or ramp for sprints
equipment_tags.track: open flat space of 30 m or more

exercises.name: Goblet squat (one loaded handle at the chest)
exercises.cue: 3 s down, 1 s pause, drive up; heels flat

exercises.name: Tempo squat, bodyweight
exercises.cue: 4 s down, 1 s pause, fast up

exercises.name: Barbell back squat (light, no rack: lift the bar onto your shoulders from the floor)
exercises.cue: brace, sit between the hips, stop the set if the bar drifts forward; no rack means light loads only

exercises.name: Dumbbell front squat
exercises.cue: dumbbells on the shoulders, elbows up

exercises.name: Static split squat with dumbbells
exercises.cue: 3 s lowering, front shin vertical, both feet stay planted

exercises.name: Rear-foot-elevated split squat (Bulgarian)
exercises.cue: rear foot on the step, torso slightly forward, slow lowering

exercises.name: Reverse lunge with dumbbells
exercises.cue: step back, lower the back knee to just above the floor, push through the front heel

exercises.name: Alternating forward lunge with dumbbells
exercises.cue: alternate legs, control the landing

exercises.name: Step-up with dumbbells
exercises.cue: the working leg does the lifting; lower for 3 s; the step should be knee height or lower

exercises.name: Skater squat (single-leg squat to a cushion), bodyweight
exercises.cue: slow, touch the cushion lightly, stand without a bounce

exercises.name: Romanian deadlift (two legs)
exercises.cue: hips back, flat back, bar close to the legs, feel the hamstrings, stop when the back would round

exercises.name: Single-leg Romanian deadlift
exercises.cue: touch a wall with one hand for balance, hips square, slow lowering

exercises.name: Good morning with a barbell or handle across the shoulders (light)
exercises.cue: soft knees, hips back, light load only

exercises.name: Two-hand dumbbell swing
exercises.cue: hip snap, arms are ropes; stop when the hinge turns into a squat

exercises.name: Glute bridge, bodyweight
exercises.cue: ribs down, squeeze at the top 1-2 s

exercises.name: Single-leg glute bridge
exercises.cue: hips level, slow lowering

exercises.name: Hip thrust from the floor with a barbell or dumbbell on the hips
exercises.cue: upper back on the floor or a low support, chin tucked, full lockout

exercises.name: Hip thrust with the upper back on a bench
exercises.cue: bench at the shoulder blades, pause at the top

exercises.name: Nordic hamstring curl (heels anchored)
exercises.cue: kneel, heels held, lower as slowly as you can with hips extended, catch yourself, push back up lightly; 2-3 reps to start

exercises.name: Slider or towel hamstring curl (bridge position)
exercises.cue: heels on a towel, hips up, pull the heels in, slow return

exercises.name: Band hamstring curl
exercises.cue: anchor low, slow return

exercises.name: Single-leg calf raise (knee straight)
exercises.cue: 2 s up, 1 s pause, 3 s down; full range on a step edge if you have one

exercises.name: Bent-knee calf raise (soleus)
exercises.cue: dumbbell on the knee while seated, or knees bent standing, slow tempo

exercises.name: Calf raise, bodyweight
exercises.cue: slow tempo, hold the top 1 s

exercises.name: Floor press with dumbbells or a barbell
exercises.cue: lie on the floor, elbows at about 45 degrees, pause the upper arms on the floor

exercises.name: Dumbbell bench press
exercises.cue: shoulder blades back, controlled lowering

exercises.name: Band chest press
exercises.cue: anchor behind you at chest height

exercises.name: Standing overhead press with dumbbells
exercises.cue: ribs down, press in a straight line, no back arch

exercises.name: Half-kneeling single-arm press
exercises.cue: tall posture, squeeze the glute of the kneeling leg

exercises.name: One-arm dumbbell row (free hand on a chair or thigh)
exercises.cue: pull the elbow to the hip, pause 1 s

exercises.name: Bent-over row with a barbell or two dumbbells
exercises.cue: flat back, row to the lower ribs

exercises.name: Band row
exercises.cue: anchor at chest height, squeeze the shoulder blades

exercises.name: Band pull-apart (no anchor needed)
exercises.cue: arms straight, pull to the chest line, slow return

exercises.name: Band face pull
exercises.cue: anchor at face height, elbows high

exercises.name: Band lat pulldown
exercises.cue: anchor overhead, pull to the upper chest

exercises.name: Lat pulldown (gym machine)
exercises.cue: pull to the upper chest, controlled return

exercises.name: Side plank
exercises.cue: straight line from head to feet, breathe

exercises.name: Dead bug
exercises.cue: low back pressed down, slow opposite arm and leg

exercises.name: Bird dog
exercises.cue: square hips, 2 s hold at the top

exercises.name: Front plank
exercises.cue: squeeze glutes, ribs down

exercises.name: Suitcase carry (one dumbbell, walk tall)
exercises.cue: do not lean; 20-30 m each side

exercises.name: Pallof press (band, anti-rotation)
exercises.cue: press out, hold 2 s, do not twist

exercises.name: Pogo hops (stiff ankles, small fast hops)
exercises.cue: quiet landings, short ground contact; count contacts

exercises.name: Squat jump, bodyweight
exercises.cue: jump for height, land soft, reset between reps

exercises.name: Split squat jump
exercises.cue: switch legs in the air, soft landing

exercises.name: Standing broad jump
exercises.cue: swing arms, stick the landing, walk back, full rest

exercises.name: Box jump (step down, do not jump down)
exercises.cue: stable box at a height you can land on softly

exercises.name: Skater bound (lateral bounds)
exercises.cue: push off one leg, stick the landing on the other

exercises.name: Wall drive march (acceleration posture drill)
exercises.cue: lean on a wall at about 45 degrees, drive one knee up, rapid foot strike under the hip

exercises.name: Acceleration sprints, 10-30 m from a standing or falling start
exercises.cue: full warm-up first; full recovery (2-3 min) between reps; stop when speed drops

exercises.name: Sled or hill sprints (resisted acceleration)
exercises.cue: light-to-moderate resistance, 10-20 m, full recovery

exercises.name: Short hill sprints (6-10 s)
exercises.cue: gentle gradient, drive the arms, walk down for recovery

exercises.name: Dumbbell biceps curl
exercises.cue: no swinging

exercises.name: Overhead dumbbell triceps extension
exercises.cue: elbows in, full stretch

exercises.name: Push-up
exercises.cue: straight line, chest to the floor

exercises.name: Pull-up
exercises.cue: full hang to chin over the bar

exercises.name: Chin-up
exercises.cue: underhand grip, full hang

exercises.name: Side-lying hip abduction (top leg lifts, toes forward)
exercises.cue: hips stacked, lift the top leg without rolling back, slow lowering

exercises.name: Banded lateral walk (band above the knees)
exercises.cue: half squat, small steps sideways, keep tension on the band; 10-15 steps each way

exercises.name: Slow step-down from a step (eccentric control)
exercises.cue: stand on the step, lower the other heel to the floor over 4-5 s, knee tracks over the toes, tap and come back

exercises.name: Step-down with dumbbells
exercises.cue: lower for 4-5 s, light touch with the heel, drive back up with the working leg
